title: Cut-out
description: A sea-and-sky photo printed as a scanned magazine page, halftone dots and power lines and all, with "it must be out there." glued on a strip of newsprint. Type a line and it prints onto a fresh scissor-cut strip; drag strips around the page and they lift on a soft shadow and land with a paper tap.
intent: One collage gesture finished to the edge: words cut out of newsprint and laid on a printed sky, every strip its own piece of paper with a hand-cut edge, a reverse-side show-through and weight when you move it.
sources: herb reference board: 039a magazine cut-out 'it must be out there.' on a scanned sky
